body.interpretation: (1) Non-zero-guarded 64-bit increment of the script-frame field at +0x20 (FFrame::NextLocalVar) — the universal UE native exec prologue. (2) Tail-jump to shared tail 0x141d73560: if N = [this+0xc44] <= 0, skip; else zero int32 entries [this+0xc30 + 4*i] for i in [0, N). No return value, no other side effects. Structurally identical to the sibling ClearResourcesGivenPerRound (0x1428c8aa0) with the array base swapped 0xc14 -> 0xc30.

field_proofs: 0xc30 = ResourcesGivenToWinnersPerRound array, 5 x int32 (0xc30..0xc43): write target of this clear; read by GetResourceGivenToWinnersPerRound 0x141d84dd0 as *(this+0xc30 + e*4) with bound [this+0xc44]; written by SetResourceGivenToWinnersPerRound 0x141d91030 with the same bound.

0xc44 = int32 entry count for the 0xc30 array: bound in 0x141d84dd0 ('count <= e -> return 0') and 0x141d91030 ('e < count'); ALSO the loop bound of this clear (0x141d73566/0x141d73589) — consistent with its own getter/setter pair. Not reflected (field-offset 0xc44 -> []).
Array sizing: 0xc44-0xc30 = 0x14 (5 int32s); EFortResourceType has 6 enumerators (Wood..None, values 0..5) so a 5-slot array + shared count field is consistent with index-by-resource-type storage.
